t: Listen to a conversation between a student and an advisor.
I'd like to take the marine biology course next term, but the system says it's full.
That happens a lot with that course.
Professor Okafor sometimes opens a few extra seats in the first week.
Let me check whether she's keeping a waiting list this year.
If she is, I'll put your name on it.
In the meantime, register for a backup course so you don't fall below full-time status.
I'll sign up for introductory geology, then.
